changes.comment: Regenerate the spelling table from the VarCon dataset (Kevin Atkinson's SCOWL / English Speller Database), expanding it from ~1,379 to ~5,200 curated entries. The generator now lives in the @americanize/spelling-data-generator tool (TypeScript, using @rushstack/node-core-library); it pins the source by content hash, filters to common/verified entries, and applies the ambiguous-word overrides. Adds NOTICE.md attribution.
